desc: The Everyday Fanny Pack just got larger with the Everyday Fanny Pack+. It keeps all the great features of the original and is now big enough to fit full-size frames with lights and optics. The Everyday+ also adds a new micro rapid access puller and holster retention accessory, so you're ready to go as soon as it arrives. Made with sleek exterior fabric for better water resistance and style, plus a secure buckle system to hold essentials in place as you move through any terrain, this pack is built for those who never settle. Stay prepared and carry confidently every day.
